findings.title: ADO WorkItem/Wiki/TestPlan: config_url imported but organization_url not updated
findings.problem: AzureDevOpsWorkItemConfig, AzureDevOpsWikiConfig, and AzureDevOpsTestPlanConfig each import config_url in this diff but the organization_url = RequiredField(...) call is unchanged — no default=config_url('DEFAULT_AZURE_DEVOPS_TOOL_URL') argument was added. Plan Task 6 Step 1 is marked [x] complete but the implementation for three of the four Azure DevOps configs is missing.
findings.impact: These three configs do not receive deployment-configurable organization_url defaults, defeating the feature's purpose for the majority of Azure DevOps usage. AzureDevOpsGitConfig.url was correctly updated; the three sub-service configs were not. The imports are dead code.
findings.recommendation: In each of the three files, add default=config_url("DEFAULT_AZURE_DEVOPS_TOOL_URL") to the organization_url RequiredField(...) call — identical pattern to AzureDevOpsGitConfig. Also add model-level tests: a placeholder assertion and a test_ado_<service>_organization_url_default_url_override test for each.

findings.title: Per-model test_*_default_url_override tests missing for 5 integrations
findings.problem: ElasticConfig, KubernetesConfig, ServiceNowConfig, ReportPortalConfig, and SonarConfig have no model-level default-value or override tests. AzureDevOpsWorkItemConfig test file has a placeholder assertion but no default-value test or override test. No test files exist for ADO wiki and test_plan (required by CR-001 fix). Spec requires both a default-value assertion and a named test_*_default_url_override per integration.
findings.impact: Regressions in these integrations' URL wiring go undetected by CI. test_config_url.py covers the generic config_url() mechanism but does not verify each model's Field definition actually wires to the correct config attr — a typo in the config_attr string would pass all existing tests.
findings.recommendation: For Elastic, Kubernetes, ServiceNow, ReportPortal, Sonar: add test_<integration>_url_default_value and test_<integration>_url_default_url_override following the Jira/GitLab test pattern. After fixing CR-001, add equivalent tests for ADO wiki and test_plan.

findings.title: validate_oauth_fields does not guard whitespace-only oauth_authority/oauth_scope
findings.problem: The new model_validator uses `if not self.oauth_authority` which passes for whitespace-only strings like ' ' when auth_type is OAUTH_AZURE.
findings.impact: EmailToolConfig with auth_type=OAUTH_AZURE constructed with oauth_authority=' ' passes model validation and reaches the OAuth token acquisition call with an effectively empty authority URL, causing an opaque network error at send time rather than a clear validation failure at construction.
findings.recommendation: Change `if not self.oauth_authority:` to `if not (self.oauth_authority and self.oauth_authority.strip()):` and apply the same fix to the oauth_scope check.
